FOOTNOTES

1/ This appropriation is a continuing appropriation and is exempt from the provisions of section 35-190, Arizona Revised Statutes, relating to lapsing of appropriations. (General Appropriations Act footnote)

2/ General Appropriations Act funds are appropriated as an Operating Lump Sum with Special Line Items by Agency.

Operating Budget

The Baseline includes \$1,806,200 and 14.5 FTE Positions from the RUCO Revolving Fund in FY 2027 for the operating budget. These amounts are unchanged from FY 2026.

Professional Witnesses

The budget includes \$145,000 from the RUCO Revolving Fund in FY 2027 for Professional Witnesses. This amount is unchanged from FY 2026.

Monies in this line item are used to fund expert witness testimony at utility rate hearings.
